nodes.title: Conformance and interoperability
nodes.summary: Turn exact normative requirements into cross-implementation behavior and reusable minimized regression fixtures.
artifactRequirements: A version-pinned conformance matrix with executable positive and negative cases.
Independent results from at least two implementation or toolchain roots.
Minimized, reproducible divergence fixtures with explicit expected behavior.
revalidationTriggers: A referenced standard is updated, obsoleted, or gains relevant errata.
A tested implementation changes its parser, state machine, or cryptographic backend.

nodes.title: Constant-time and memory-safety evidence
nodes.summary: Relate source and binary behavior to explicit leakage, memory, range, and fault models.
artifactRequirements: A pinned source and binary digest with compiler, flags, platform, and measurement environment.
A declared leakage or memory-safety model and reproducible analysis method.
Evidence that distinguishes source-level, binary-level, statistical, and formal claims.
revalidationTriggers: Compiler, optimization flags, target architecture, dependency, or implementation revision changes.
The leakage, memory, or fault model changes.

nodes.title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure
nodes.summary: Reduce harm while independently validating, repairing, and eventually publishing security findings.
artifactRequirements: A disclosure policy with acknowledgement, reproduction, fix, disclosure, and escalation deadlines.
A confidential-evidence handling plan that excludes exploit plaintext and target-identifying metadata from public ledgers.
A sanitized publication template preserving method, scope, credit, and repair evidence.
revalidationTriggers: Disclosure policy, legal constraints, vendor contact, or neutral escalation path changes.
A finding changes from theoretical to operationally exploitable.

standards.title: CERT Guide to Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure

nodes.title: Differential testing and fuzzing
nodes.summary: Generate bounded inputs, compare independent oracles, minimize divergences, and preserve exact reproductions.
artifactRequirements: A deterministic corpus generator with seed and toolchain digests.
At least two justified oracles or implementations and a divergence classifier.
Minimized reproducers that preserve exact input bytes and environment.
revalidationTriggers: Generator, oracle, parser, dependency, or implementation versions change.
Coverage claims or target threat models change.

nodes.title: Formal protocol and implementation verification
nodes.summary: State exact theorems, assumptions, bounds, refinement claims, and reproducible checker environments.
artifactRequirements: The exact theorem, model, attacker assumptions, bounds, and mapping to a pinned specification or implementation.
A reproducible checker environment with all axioms, admits, trusted bases, and generated artifacts disclosed.
An independent check that distinguishes bounded model exploration, protocol proof, and implementation proof.
revalidationTriggers: The theorem, model, trusted base, checker, specification, or implementation mapping changes.
A counterexample invalidates an assumption or refinement step.

nodes.title: Known-answer and negative test vectors
nodes.summary: Bind exact bytes, parameters, expected outputs, rejection behavior, and provenance into reusable test oracles.
artifactRequirements: Canonical input and output bytes with generator provenance and exact parameter identifiers.
Positive, boundary, malformed, and rejection cases tied to normative requirements.
A deterministic runner and a statement of what passing does and does not establish.
revalidationTriggers: Standard text, errata, parameter registry, serialization, generator, or implementation behavior changes.

nodes.title: Authenticated encryption with associated data
nodes.summary: Reason about nonce discipline, authenticity, confidentiality, key separation, bounds, and misuse limits.
artifactRequirements: A security-game analysis with explicit nonce, key, query, forgery, and data limits.
Exact-byte vectors covering associated data, empty inputs, failure, and nonce-boundary behavior.
A toy or wrapper implementation explicitly barred from unreviewed production use.
revalidationTriggers: Primitive, parameter, nonce policy, usage bound, library, or protocol composition changes.

nodes.title: Classical public-key cryptography
nodes.summary: Connect finite-field and elliptic-curve assumptions to encodings, signatures, key exchange, and validation.
artifactRequirements: A reduction or attack analysis with exact group, curve, encoding, and validation assumptions.
Negative vectors for malformed points, subgroup behavior, signatures, and key agreement inputs.
A composition note distinguishing primitive guarantees from protocol guarantees.
revalidationTriggers: Algorithm, curve, group, encoding, validation rule, library, or protocol composition changes.

nodes.title: Hash, MAC, and key-derivation discipline
nodes.summary: Reason about collision, preimage, pseudorandomness, extraction, expansion, and domain or key separation.
artifactRequirements: Exact-byte exercises demonstrating encoding, domain separation, truncation, salt, context, and key separation.
A security-property matrix that does not substitute collision resistance for MAC or KDF guarantees.
A toy or wrapper implementation explicitly barred from unreviewed production use.
revalidationTriggers: Primitive, parameter, encoding, domain-separation label, library, or protocol composition changes.

nodes.title: ML-DSA under FIPS 204
nodes.summary: Connect module-lattice signature mathematics to exact FIPS 204 algorithms, parameters, encodings, and implementation evidence.
artifactRequirements: Exact FIPS 204 parameter, serialization, signing, verification, and rejection vectors.
A reproducible link between reference algorithms and an implementation revision.
Errata-aware evidence that distinguishes algorithm conformance from module certification.
revalidationTriggers: NIST publishes corrections, errata, implementation guidance, or a revised edition.
Sampling, arithmetic, serialization, randomness, or implementation revision changes.

nodes.title: ML-KEM under FIPS 203 and SP 800-227
nodes.summary: Connect module-lattice KEM mathematics to exact FIPS 203 algorithms and NIST secure-use guidance.
artifactRequirements: Exact parameter, serialization, encapsulation, decapsulation, malformed-ciphertext, and implicit-rejection vectors.
A reproducible link between FIPS algorithms, SP 800-227 usage requirements, and an implementation revision.
Errata-aware evidence that distinguishes algorithm conformance from module certification.
revalidationTriggers: NIST publishes corrections, errata, KEM guidance, or a revised edition.
Arithmetic, serialization, implicit rejection, randomness, or implementation revision changes.

nodes.title: SLH-DSA under FIPS 205
nodes.summary: Connect hash-based signature structures to exact FIPS 205 algorithms, parameters, encodings, and implementation evidence.
artifactRequirements: Exact FIPS 205 parameter, serialization, signing, verification, and rejection vectors.
A reproducible link between the hash-based construction and an implementation revision.
Evidence that distinguishes algorithm conformance from module certification.
revalidationTriggers: NIST publishes corrections, errata, implementation guidance, or a revised edition.
Hash instantiation, addressing, serialization, randomness, or implementation revision changes.

nodes.title: Finite-field and elliptic-curve algebra
nodes.summary: Construct and audit arguments over groups, rings, finite fields, scalar multiplication, and encodings.
artifactRequirements: Checkable exercises covering group order, fields, inverses, subgroups, curves, and point encodings.
At least one counterexample showing how an omitted validation condition breaks an argument.
A reproducible algebra notebook or proof artifact with no hidden assumptions.
revalidationTriggers: The assessment theorem set, proof checker, or encoding model changes.

nodes.title: Lattices and polynomial rings
nodes.summary: Relate linear algebra modulo q, quotient rings, distributions, transforms, and lattice assumptions.
artifactRequirements: Checkable exercises over modules, quotient rings, sampling, noise growth, and number-theoretic transforms.
A reduction map that names every assumption and parameter dependency.
A reproducible arithmetic artifact with boundary and range cases.
revalidationTriggers: The assumption, parameter, arithmetic model, assessment theorem set, or checker changes.

nodes.title: Probability, information, and complexity
nodes.summary: Work precisely with conditional probability, entropy, negligible functions, reductions, and randomized algorithms.
artifactRequirements: Checkable exercises in conditional probability, entropy, asymptotics, negligible bounds, and reductions.
At least one explicit failure caused by conditioning, independence, or asymptotic misuse.
A reproducible proof or computation artifact with parameterized bounds.
revalidationTriggers: The assessment theorem set, checker, probability model, or complexity model changes.

nodes.title: Proof construction and counterexamples
nodes.summary: State propositions, quantify assumptions, prove invariants, construct counterexamples, and separate evidence from confidence.
artifactRequirements: A checkable portfolio using direct proof, induction, contradiction, invariants, and counterexamples.
Every theorem states its assumptions, quantifiers, domain, and falsifiers.
At least one repaired proof whose original hidden assumption is made explicit.
revalidationTriggers: The assessment theorem set, proof checker, trusted base, or review rubric changes.

nodes.title: Cosmos SDK and IBC migration assurance
nodes.summary: Prove state, sign-byte, AppHash, consensus, and packet-lifecycle behavior across a supported release-family migration.
artifactRequirements: A source/target release-family matrix with exact SDK, CometBFT, IBC-Go, Go, and protobuf versions.
Deterministic store migration, export/import, sign-byte, AppHash, replay, and rollback evidence.
IBC client, connection, channel, packet, timeout, relayer, and proof fixtures across independent implementations where available.
revalidationTriggers: Cosmos release-family or IBC-Go support policy changes.
SDK, CometBFT, IBC-Go, Go, protobuf, store schema, or upgrade handler changes.
A relevant security advisory or consensus-breaking change is published.

nodes.title: HPKE under RFC 9180
nodes.summary: Test HPKE modes, suite identifiers, labeled key schedule, nonce construction, exporters, validation, and composition assumptions.
artifactRequirements: Parity with official RFC 9180 vectors for every claimed mode and suite.
Negative cases for identifiers, keys, context, exporter, sequence, nonce, and input validation.
A composition note limiting claims to RFC 9180 and the declared application protocol.
revalidationTriggers: The IETF standards-track HPKE successor changes state or revision.
RFC 9180 errata, registry, suite, dependency, or implementation behavior changes.

standards.title: Hybrid Public Key Encryption
standards.authorityStatus: Informational RFC; IETF standards-track successor pending

nodes.title: Messaging Layer Security under RFC 9420
nodes.summary: Model TreeKEM state, epochs, proposals, commits, joins, authentication, forward secrecy, and post-compromise security assumptions.
artifactRequirements: A pinned MLS cipher suite and complete normative dependency closure.
Vector parity against mlswg/mls-implementations commit cfd450286d1bfd9cd2519b95c80f9771f94a5b1a plus multi-epoch add, update, remove, join, PSK, stale-proposal, and negative-transition cases.
An explicit separation between protocol, authentication-service, delivery-service, and implementation assumptions.
revalidationTriggers: RFC 9420 errata, extension, cipher-suite registry, HPKE dependency, or implementation behavior changes.
The application authentication or delivery model changes.

standards.title: Hybrid Public Key Encryption
standards.authorityStatus: Informational RFC; IETF standards-track successor pending

nodes.title: OAuth Security BCP and FAPI 2.0
nodes.summary: Bind browser, authorization-server, client, resource-server, issuer, redirect, token, sender-constraining, and replay behavior to current security profiles.
artifactRequirements: Negative conformance cases for exact redirects, issuer mix-up, PKCE, PAR, sender constraining, replay, and key rotation.
A mapping from implementation behavior to RFC 9700 and the FAPI 2.0 attacker-model assumptions.
Tests limited to owned local deployments or explicitly authorized targets.
revalidationTriggers: OAuth BCP, registry, FAPI profile, attacker model, conformance suite, browser, or implementation behavior changes.

standards.title: Best Current Practice for OAuth 2.0 Security

nodes.title: QUIC v1 transport and TLS integration
nodes.summary: Test QUIC transport and TLS integration as one pinned security scope rather than treating RFC 9000 alone as sufficient.
artifactRequirements: Exact Initial secret, Retry, packet protection, header protection, packet-number, key-update, migration, and state-transition vectors.
A compound RFC 9000 and RFC 9001 conformance scope with explicit RFC 9002 inclusion only when loss recovery is tested.
Cross-implementation fixtures executed only in owned or authorized environments.
revalidationTriggers: QUIC RFC errata, extension, registry, TLS dependency, interop runner, or implementation behavior changes.

standards.title: QUIC: A UDP-Based Multiplexed and Secure Transport

nodes.title: in-toto, SLSA, and Sigstore verification
nodes.summary: Separate authenticated statements, artifact binding, transparency evidence, builder identity, and semantic policy.
artifactRequirements: Cross-language Statement, DSSE PAE, subject-digest, predicate, and canonical-value fixtures.
Exact Sigstore bundle media-type, identity, trust-root, time, inclusion, offline, and failure-policy tests.
A SLSA policy that distinguishes signed provenance from evidence that builder and workflow expectations were satisfied.
revalidationTriggers: in-toto, SLSA, Sigstore bundle, trust root, transparency log, conformance suite, or verifier policy changes.
A referenced mutable project status changes.

standards.title: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts specification

nodes.title: TLS 1.3 under RFC 9846
nodes.summary: Treat RFC 9846, which obsoletes RFC 8446 while retaining TLS 1.3, as an exact executable state and byte contract.
artifactRequirements: An executable RFC 8446 to RFC 9846 delta map with exact normative citations and each tested stack commit's claimed RFC profile.
A directional RFC 9846 Section 4.3.8 oracle: senders must not reuse a KeyShare across connections, while receivers must permit peer reuse for interoperability.
Transcript, key-schedule, KeyShare, HelloRetryRequest, 0-RTT, KeyUpdate, alert, and negative-state fixtures.
Results from independent TLS implementations executed only in owned or authorized environments; RFC 8446-only sender reuse is recorded as an adoption gap, not RFC 9846 nonconformance.
revalidationTriggers: RFC 9846 gains errata, updates, obsoletion, registry changes, or security guidance.
TLS implementation, cryptographic backend, extension, or test oracle changes.

The Transport Layer Security (TLS) Protocol Version 1.3

nodes.title: WebAuthn Level 2 relying-party verification
nodes.summary: Test origin, RP ID, challenge, ceremony, authenticator data, CBOR, signature, counter, user-presence, user-verification, and recovery assumptions.
artifactRequirements: Relying-party negative vectors for origin, RP ID, challenge single use, CBOR, algorithm policy, flags, counters, and backup state.
A virtual-authenticator or owned-device harness with exact browser, authenticator, and verifier versions.
A separate account-recovery and synchronized-credential threat model.
revalidationTriggers: The dated Level 2 Recommendation, relevant errata, browser, authenticator, CBOR, algorithm, or recovery behavior changes.
Level 3 reaches a new maturity state relevant to the tested behavior.

standards.title: Web Authentication: An API for accessing Public Key Credentials Level 2

nodes.title: Season 0: MLS state-machine invariants
nodes.summary: Bind explicit MLS attacker assumptions and state invariants to a pinned mlswg interoperability corpus, negative transitions, and independent implementations.
artifactRequirements: A mechanized or executable RFC 9420 state model with explicit cipher suite, dependencies, attacker assumptions, and bounds.
Vector parity against mlswg/mls-implementations commit cfd450286d1bfd9cd2519b95c80f9771f94a5b1a and negative multi-epoch add, update, remove, join, proposal, commit, PSK, and stale-state cases.
Independent execution against at least two MLS implementation roots with minimized interoperability repairs.
Unexpected failures and counterexamples are quarantined before public logs until disclosure triage classifies them as safe.
revalidationTriggers: RFC 9420, its HPKE dependency, cipher-suite registry, pinned mlswg interoperability corpus, checker, or implementation behavior changes.
A result changes an adversarial accept/reject decision and requires confidential handling.

nodes.title: Season 0: FIPS 203/204/205 cross-library assurance
nodes.summary: Create reusable cross-library vectors, malformed inputs, errata mappings, implicit-rejection checks, and constant-time evidence.
artifactRequirements: A deterministic cross-library corpus for FIPS 203, 204, and 205 with exact implementation and toolchain versions.
A 2026-07-29 oracle snapshot of published FIPS text and NIST planning notes; announced future FIPS 203 and 204 corrections are not silently applied.
Known-answer, malformed encoding, parameter, rejection, errata, boundary, and cross-library divergence fixtures with at least three implementation roots per algorithm.
ML-KEM malformed-ciphertext and implicit-rejection checks; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA invalid-signature plus signing/randomness checks.

Constant-time evidence for every algorithm and implementation root in the bounded corpus, across the declared execution environments; memory-safety evidence where relevant, with explicit source, binary, platform, leakage, and measurement scope.
Unexpected failures, leakage evidence, and counterexamples are quarantined before public logs until disclosure triage classifies them as safe.
revalidationTriggers: NIST correction, errata, ACVP, SP 800-227, implementation, compiler, corpus, or measurement method changes.
A result changes an adversarial accept/reject decision and requires confidential handling.

nodes.title: Season 0: RFC 9846 KeyShare-reuse conformance
nodes.summary: Turn the RFC 8446 to RFC 9846 directional KeyShare sender non-reuse and receiver-tolerance requirements into executable cross-stack evidence.
artifactRequirements: An exact RFC 8446 to RFC 9846 normative delta with each tested stack commit's claimed RFC profile.
A directional RFC 9846 Section 4.3.8 oracle: senders must not reuse a KeyShare across connections, while receivers must permit peer reuse for interoperability.
Negative and conformance results from at least three independent TLS implementation roots and two execution environments.
A minimized upstream regression test or independently maintained conformance fixture with implementation receipts; RFC 8446-only sender reuse is an adoption gap, not RFC 9846 nonconformance.
Unexpected failures and counterexamples are quarantined before public logs until disclosure triage classifies them as safe.
revalidationTriggers: RFC 9846 errata, TLS registry, implementation, cryptographic backend, test oracle, or upstream fixture changes.
A result changes an adversarial accept/reject decision and requires confidential handling.

nodes.title: Side channels and fault models
nodes.summary: Specify timing, cache, power, electromagnetic, memory, compiler, microarchitectural, and fault assumptions before measuring.
artifactRequirements: A bounded leakage or fault model naming attacker access, secrets, observations, noise, platform, and limits.
A reproducible owned-device or simulated experiment with negative controls.
A conclusion scoped to the tested binary, platform, method, and statistical or formal bound.
revalidationTriggers: Attacker access, platform, compiler, binary, dependency, measurement method, or fault model changes.

nodes.title: Threat models and security games
nodes.summary: Name assets, actors, trust boundaries, capabilities, queries, wins, assumptions, exclusions, and compositional limits.
artifactRequirements: A formal or executable threat model with assets, actors, trust boundaries, attacker queries, win conditions, and exclusions.
At least one attack trace exploiting an omitted assumption and one repaired model.
A composition analysis separating primitive, protocol, implementation, deployment, and recovery claims.
revalidationTriggers: Attacker capability, trust boundary, deployment, protocol, implementation, or assessment game changes.

nodes.title: Exact bytes, parsers, and state machines
nodes.summary: Treat encoding, canonicalization, bounds, parser behavior, concurrency, replay, and transitions as part of the security proof.
artifactRequirements: A byte-exact parser and state-machine exercise with canonicalization, bounds, invalid inputs, replay, and transition invariants.
Differential fixtures exposing at least one ambiguity or divergent acceptance path.
A reproducible model or test harness with explicit concurrency and failure assumptions.
revalidationTriggers: Encoding, parser, state-machine, concurrency, canonicalization, or assessment model changes.
